newsitem.title: USA: KLA says anti-trust waiting period expire.
newsitem.headline: KLA says anti-trust waiting period expire.

text.p: KLA Instruments Corp and Tencor Instruments said the waiting period under the pre-merger notification requirement of the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976 with respect to their proposed merger has expired.

Consummation of the merger remains subject to final U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission clearance and stockholder approval. KLA and Tencor expect to hold their respective shareholders' meetings and effect the merger on April 30, 1997. Shareholders of record of the respective companies on March 7, 1997 will be entitled to vote.
